summary: Frontend-only test of the two new Supplier Portal follow-ups: (1) Bulk Cart Add 'Select all N items' per-PO toggle on the dashboard PO table, (2) Shipments page status + date-range filters. Logged in as test@test.com (vendor H1330). BOTH features work exactly as specified - 100% of the requested scenarios passed. Verified: link renders only once per PO group and only when >1 OPEN item (28792=3 items, 28897=4 items show the link; 28833 has only 1 open line -> no link); clicking checks all 3 rows and pre-fills each ship qty with its full remaining qty (7989 / 6396 / 7991); label flips to 'Deselect all' and a second click clears all (cart bar disappears, count 0); manual uncheck of one row drops cart 3->2 and the label reverts to 'Select all 3 items'; bulk-selecting a second PO accumulates (6 items, Review dialog shows exactly 6 rows); zero-open-qty rows stay disabled and are excluded from the count; PO search narrowing a group to a single open row correctly hides the link. Shipments filters: status In Transit 4/6, Received 2/6, Rejected 0/6 -> 'No shipments match these filters.' (distinct from 'No shipments yet.'); an excluding date range (2020-01-01..2020-01-31) also gives 0 of 6 with the filtered empty state; Clear button only appears when a filter is active and resets everything to 6 of 6; counter text ('N of M shipments') accurate in every combination including status+date combined; filters reset on reload (client-side state, expected). Regressions checked: login->dashboard routing, PO table columns/pricing, PO search + no-match state, cart -> Review dialog, Shipments nav, and the shipment Edit dialog all still work. No console errors. No backend changes involved, so no backend tests were run this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Select all N items' link is 10px in muted #5B738B on white and wraps to two lines inside the PO Number cell - very easy to miss and borderline on WCAG small-text contrast. Suggest 11-12px and the brand blue #0076CC (it already turns blue only on hover).

Pre-existing concern amplified: bulk select pre-fills EVERY row with the entire remaining PO qty (7989+6396+7991 in one click), so one mis-click can stage a full-PO shipment. Individual checkbox selection leaves qty blank - the two paths are inconsistent (toggleCartItem sets ship_qty:'' vs toggleSelectAllForPo sets ship_qty:p.remaining_qty).

issues: The From/To date filters use raw native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy with the OS picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere in the app - inconsistent with the design system
No validation/hint when From > To; the table just silently shows the 'No shipments match these filters.' state
Filter state is not reflected in the URL, so a filtered view can't be shared/bookmarked and is lost on reload (acceptable for MVP, noting only)

action_items: Optional polish: make the 'Select all N items' link 11-12px / #0076CC so it is discoverable and passes small-text contrast
Decide one consistent ship-qty prefill rule (bulk select fills full remaining qty, single checkbox leaves it blank) - full-qty prefill on a 3-line bulk select is risky
Optional: replace the two native date inputs on the Shipments page with the shadcn Calendar/Popover for design-system consistency
critical_code_review_comments: isPoFullySelected()/toggleSelectAllForPo() each re-run filteredPos.filter() on every render/click; rowsWithPoGroup already computes per-PO groups - reuse that map to avoid the duplicate O(N) scans and keep the 'is fully selected' logic in one place.

rowsWithPoGroup marks _isFirstOfPo on the first row of the PO in list order even if that row itself has remaining_qty 0; it works today (count comes from open rows only) but the toggle can render on a disabled row - consider anchoring it to the first OPEN row of the group.

SupplierShipmentsPage filteredShipments parses new Date(s.created_at) per row per keystroke - fine at 6 rows, but sort order is whatever the API returns; a date filter without a visible Created/Date column means the vendor is filtering on a field they cannot see. Recommend adding a Created date column to the shipments table.
SupplierDashboardPage.jsx is now 490 lines with cart, search, impersonation, detail modal and 4 dialogs in one file - approaching the point where the cart/review dialogs should be extracted.
